FQHESphere2LLBosonicStateTimePolarizedSlaters, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphere2LLBosonicStateTimePolarizedSlaters [options]

system options:

    --szsymmetrized-basis : use Sz <-> -Sz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-sz=0, override auto-detection from file name)
    --minus-szparity : select the  Sz <-> -Sz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --minus-lzparity : select the  Lz <-> -Lz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --2-ll-lz : use lz symmetry to reduce number of 2-ll boson configs taken
    --2-ll-sz : use sz symmetry to reduce number of 2-ll boson configs taken
    --mpi-stages : the number of stages divide into when using MPI  (default is 20) (default value = 20)
    --smp-stages : the number of stages divide into when using SMP  (default is 20) (default value = 20)

output options:
